messages:
alice.martin: :rotating_light: noticed that analytics service started showing 403->200 for customer data buckets around 15:12 UTC. possible RBAC change?
maya-sec: on it. can you paste the rolebinding that changed?
alice.martin: looks like a PR merged earlier today renamed group 'analytics-readers-v2' -> 'analytics-readers'. I think the migration script used a wildcard and expanded permissions. pasted snippet: `kubectl get rolebinding analytics-readers -o yaml`
raj-sre: can you paste the audit log line for the access? need principal + resource + action.
alice.martin: audit: `{"time":"2026-03-18T15:12:06Z","principal":"svc.analytics@redwood-prod","action":"s3:GetObject","resource":"arn:aws:s3:::customer-prod-data/*","result":"ALLOWED","policy":"role:analytics-readers"}`
tom-infra: that principal shouldn't have decrypt access to kms-customer-master. did the role include kms:Decrypt by accident?
sara-plat: checking role templates... PR #2748 added an allow on `kms:Decrypt` to a shared role during the rename because of a copy/paste bug. it was meant for batch-workers, not analytics.
maya-sec: immediate mitigation: remove kms decrypt from analytics role and add a deny condition for s3:GetObject on customer-prod-data for that role. can we do a quick policy patch?
raj-sre: I'll push an emergency policy patch to IAM and create a scoped deny. deploying now via apply script. `./infra/iam/apply-emergency.sh analytics-readers deny-customer-data`
deploy-bot: deploy started for iam-patch/emergency-2439990001 by raj-sre at 2026-03-18T15:20:10Z
raj-sre: patch applied. please validate if access is blocked now.
alice.martin: verified — svc.analytics now getting 403 for customer-prod-data. :thumbsup:
maya-sec: good. next steps: revert the role rename PR that introduced the wildcard and schedule a proper scoped migration. also schedule KMS key access rotation for the affected key and audit any reads between 15:12-15:20 UTC.
sara-plat: opened rollback PR #2755 and flagged for urgent review. I've also dumped list of objects accessed in that window: `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket customer-prod-data --query 'Contents[?LastModified>=`2026-03-18T15:12:00Z`]'` (results sent to sec mailbox).
maya-sec: good. Raj, can you also add a short-term denylist on the analytics service account at the platform level while we confirm scope?
raj-sre: done. blocked at the proxy for svc.analytics until 15:40 UTC or until we say otherwise.
alice.martin: thanks everyone. will follow up with customer-notify draft after we confirm there was no exfiltration. leaving this thread open for logs and postmortem notes.
